Darkvision: You can see in Dim Light within the trait's range as if it were Bright Light and in Darkness as if it were Dim Light, discerning only shades of gray there. The range is 120 feet for Dwarves and Orcs, 60 feet for other listed species, and 120 feet for Drow Elves.
Draconic Ancestry: Choose a dragon ancestor. Its damage type determines your Breath Weapon damage and Damage Resistance.
Breath Weapon: When taking the Attack action, replace one attack with a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Creatures there make a Dexterity save against DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus, taking ancestry-type damage on a failure or half on a success. Damage is 1d10, increasing to 2d10 at character level 5, 3d10 at 11, and 4d10 at 17. Uses equal your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.
Damage Resistance: You have Resistance to the damage type granted by your Draconic Ancestry.
Draconic Flight: Starting at character level 5, use a Bonus Action to gain spectral wings and a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 10 minutes. They end early if you dismiss them or become Incapacitated. Once per Long Rest.
Dwarven Resilience: You have Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.
Dwarven Toughness: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1 now and by 1 each time you gain a level.
Stonecunning: While touching stone or standing on it, use a Bonus Action to gain Tremorsense out to 60 feet for 10 minutes. Uses equal your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.
Elven Lineage: Choose Drow, High Elf, or Wood Elf. Gain its initial benefit and its listed spells at character levels 3 and 5. Each leveled spell is always prepared and can be cast once without a slot per Long Rest or with a suitable slot. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as its spellcasting ability.
Fey Ancestry: You have Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Charmed condition.
Keen Senses: Gain proficiency in Insight, Perception, or Survival.
Trance: You do not need sleep, and magic cannot put you to sleep. A 4-hour conscious trance can complete your Long Rest.
Gnomish Cunning: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.
Gnomish Lineage: Choose Forest or Rock Gnome and Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the spellcasting ability for this trait's spells. Forest Gnomes know Minor Illusion and always prepare Speak with Animals, which they can cast without a slot Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. Rock Gnomes know Mending and Prestidigitation and can create clockwork devices.
Forest Gnome Speak with Animals: Always have Speak with Animals prepared. Cast it without a slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest, or cast it using a spell slot.
Clockwork Device: Spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to make a Tiny device with AC 5 and 1 HP that produces one chosen Prestidigitation effect when activated by touch as a Bonus Action. You can have up to three devices; each lasts 8 hours or until dismantled with a touch as a Utilize action.
Giant Ancestry: Choose one Giant boon. Uses of the chosen boon equal your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.
Cloud's Jaunt: As a Bonus Action, teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
Fire's Burn: When an attack roll hits and deals damage, deal an additional 1d10 Fire damage.
Frost's Chill: When an attack roll hits and deals damage, deal an additional 1d6 Cold damage and reduce the target's Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
Hill's Tumble: When an attack roll hits and damages a Large or smaller creature, give it the Prone condition.
Stone's Endurance: When you take damage, use a Reaction to reduce it by 1d12 plus your Constitution modifier.
Storm's Thunder: When a creature within 60 feet damages you, use a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to it.
Large Form: Starting at character level 5, use a Bonus Action to become Large for up to 10 minutes if space permits. You have Advantage on Strength checks and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Once per Long Rest.
Powerful Build: You have Advantage on checks to end the Grappled condition and count as one size larger for carrying capacity.
Brave: You have Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Frightened condition.
Halfling Nimbleness: You can move through the space of a creature larger than you, but cannot stop there.
Luck: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for a D20 Test, reroll it and use the new result.
Naturally Stealthy: You can take the Hide action while obscured only by a creature at least one size larger than you.
Resourceful: Gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.
Skillful: Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.
Versatile: Gain one Origin feat of your choice.
Adrenaline Rush: Take the Dash action as a Bonus Action and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Uses equal your Proficiency Bonus, regained on a Short or Long Rest.
Relentless Endurance: When reduced to 0 Hit Points without being killed outright, drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once per Long Rest.
Fiendish Legacy: Choose Abyssal, Chthonic, or Infernal. Gain its level 1 Resistance and cantrip and its listed spells at character levels 3 and 5. Each leveled spell is always prepared and can be cast once without a slot per Long Rest or with a suitable slot. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as its spellcasting ability.
Otherworldly Presence: Know the Thaumaturgy cantrip, using the spellcasting ability chosen for Fiendish Legacy.
